gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all screen tabs available in the Jira system to understand the layout options for my project.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of all screen tabs, including their IDs and names, allowing me to see what is available for configuration.

gold.user: As a developer, I need to get all tabs for a specific screen in order to modify the screen layout for issue types.

gold.user: As an administrator, I need to remove an unnecessary tab from a screen to streamline the user interface.
gold.ideal: The API should delete the specified tab and confirm the deletion with a success message.
